description: This file defines a common base class and exceptions for LLM provider implementations within a language model framework. It includes abstract methods for transforming requests and responses, handling environment setup, and managing streaming configurations, as well as utility functions for request signing, URL construction, and response handling.

classes.name: BaseLLMException
classes.description: Custom exception class representing errors from LLM providers, encapsulating HTTP response details and status.

classes.description: Abstract base class for LLM configuration, providing methods for request/response handling, environment validation, and request signing.
